input.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# setup.sh — reads from .env.test and sets up the environment

set -euo pipefail

ENV_FILE="$(dirname "$0")/../.env.test"

if [[ ! -f "$ENV_FILE" ]]; then
  echo "Error: .env.test not found at $ENV_FILE" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# Source all variables from .env.test
set -o allexport
# shellcheck source=../.env.test
source "$ENV_FILE"
set +o allexport

# Derive ADMIN_TOKEN from the API_KEY entry in .env.test
export ADMIN_TOKEN="$(cat .env.test | grep API_KEY | cut -d= -f2)"

echo "Environment set up successfully from .env.test"
echo "ADMIN_TOKEN is configured."
